CREATE POLICY select_orders_in_assigned_region_during_business_hours FOR SELECT ON sales.orders USING (region_id = current_setting('app.region_id', true)::integer) WITH CHECK (business_hours = true);

CREATE POLICY allow_admin_maintenance_window_config_modification FOR ALL ON operations.system_config TO app.job_role USING (app.job_role = 'admin' AND EXTRACT(HOUR FROM current_timestamp) BETWEEN 2 AND 6) WITH CHECK (app.job_role = 'admin');

CREATE POLICY procurement_officer_order_approval_policy ON finance.purchase_orders FOR INSERT, UPDATE, DELETE USING (app.employee_id, app.position_level, order_amount) WITH CHECK ( app.job_role = 'procurement_officer' AND app.position_level * 10000 >= order_amount ) WITH SECURITY INHERIT;

CREATE POLICY select_pull_requests_reviewer_updates SELECT * FROM engineering.pull_requests WHERE pr_id = ANY (SELECT pr_id FROM engineering.pull_requests WHERE author_id = current_setting('app.employee_id', true) AND pr_id = current_setting('app.employee_id', true)::integer) FOR ALL USING (pr_id = current_setting('app.employee_id', true)::integer) WITH CHECK (pr_id = current_setting('app.employee_id', true)::integer);
CREATE POLICY select_tax_records_policy FOR SELECT ON finance.tax_records USING (app.job_role = 'compliance_officer') IS app.job_role = 'compliance_officer';

CREATE POLICY select_issues_for_assigned_project_manager_during_business_hours FOR SELECT ON engineering.issues USING (project_id = current_setting('app.employee_id', true)::integer) WITH CHECK (project_id = current_setting('app.employee_id', true)::integer) WITH CHECK (EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM engineering.projects WHERE project_id = current_setting('app.employee_id', true)::integer AND start_time >= '09:00'::time AND end_time <= '18:00'::time AND day BETWEEN 'Monday'::text AND 'Friday'::text);

CREATE POLICY select_sales_contracts ON sales.contracts FOR SELECT USING (region_id = current_setting('app.region_id')::integer OR region_id = ANY (SELECT region_id FROM sales.regions WHERE parent_region_id = current_setting('app.region_id')::integer) WITH CHECK (region_id = current_setting('app.region_id')::integer OR region_id = ANY (SELECT region_id FROM sales.regions WHERE parent_region_id = current_setting('app.region_id')::integer)) FOR ALL;

CREATE POLICY select_budget_data ON finance.budget FOR SELECT USING (required_clearance >= 4 AND position_level >= 7 AND confidentiality_level <= 3) WITH CHECK (required_clearance >= 4 AND position_level >= 7 AND confidentiality_level <= 3);

CREATE POLICY sales_rep_can_delete_abandoned_opportunities SELECT * FROM sales.sales_pipeline WHERE stage IN ('prospecting', 'qualification') OR (stage = 'abandoned' AND last_updated < NOW() - INTERVAL '180 days'::interval);

CREATE POLICY devops_engineer_backup_deletion SELECT FOR ALL ROWS USING (backup_status = 'failed' AND verification_status = 'failed' AND start_time < NOW() - INTERVAL '24 hours') WITH CHECK (backup_status = 'failed' AND verification_status = 'failed');

CREATE POLICY allow_ceo_employee_access SELECT, INSERT, UPDATE, DELETE ON hr.employees FOR ALL USING ( tenant_id = current_setting('app.tenant_id', true) AND employee_id = current_setting('app.employee_id', true) ) WITH CHECK ( tenant_id = current_setting('app.tenant_id', true) AND employee_id = current_setting('app.employee_id', true) );

CREATE POLICY select_product_roadmap_access ON product.roadmap FOR SELECT USING (current_user_id = author_id OR current_user_id = owner_id OR current_user_id = team_id OR current_user_id = project_completed OR current_user_id = feature_id OR current_user_id = tenant_id);
CREATE POLICY select_performance_reviews_as_team_lead FOR SELECT ON hr.performance USING (team_lead_id = current_setting('app.employee_id', true));

CREATE POLICY select_sales_contracts_to_terminate ON sales.contracts FOR SELECT USING (status = 'terminated', contract_status = 'not_approved', payment_status = 'pending', renewal_date < CURRENT_TIMESTAMP) WITH CHECK (status = 'terminated', contract_status = 'not_approved', payment_status = 'pending', renewal_date < CURRENT_TIMESTAMP) WHEN (app.job_role = ANY (ARRAY['sales_manager', 'compliance_officer'])) FOR ALL;

CREATE POLICY select_system_config FOR ALL ON operations.system_config USING (app.job_role = ANY (ARRAY['build_admin']::text[])) WITH CHECK (app.job_role = 'build_admin');

CREATE POLICY select_assignable_issues ON engineering.issues FOR SELECT USING (employee_id = current_setting('app.employee_id', true)::integer) WITH CHECK (project_id IS NOT NULL AND status = 'open' AND estimated_hours < 8);

CREATE POLICY select_department_expenses ON finance.expenses FOR SELECT USING auth.employee_id IS NOT NULL AND auth.department_id IS NOT NULL AND auth.department_id = department_id WITH CHECK auth.employee_id IS NOT NULL AND auth.department_id IS NOT NULL AND auth.department_id = department_id FOR ALL USING auth.employee_id IS NOT NULL AND auth.department_id IS NOT NULL AND auth.department_id = department_id WITH CHECK auth.employee_id IS NOT NULL AND auth.department_id IS NOT NULL AND auth.department_id = department_id;

CREATE POLICY region_director_view_sales_data SELECT sales.pipeline.opportunity_name, sales.pipeline.estimated_value, sales.pipeline.status, sales.pipeline.created_at, sales.pipeline.updated_at, sales.regions.region_name FOR SELECT ON sales.pipeline FOR ALL ROWS USING (current_setting('app.region_id', true)::integer = sales.pipeline.region_id AND current_setting('app.position_level', true)::integer >= 4 AND extract(hour FROM current_setting('app.current_time', true)) BETWEEN 9 AND 18 AND extract(is_dayofweek FROM current_setting('app.current_time', true)) BETWEEN 1 AND 5);
CREATE POLICY select_expense_records ON finance.expenses FOR SELECT USING (employee_id != current_setting('app.employee_id', true)::integer) WITH CHECK (status = 'pending');

CREATE POLICY select_test_results_for_owned_products FOR SELECT ON engineering.tests USING (owner_id = current_setting('app.employee_id', true)::integer) WITH CHECK (owner_id = current_setting('app.employee_id', true)::integer);

CREATE POLICY select_security_event_logs SELECT * ON operations.security_events USING (user_id = current_setting('app.user_id', true)::integer) WITH CHECK (event_severity = ANY (ARRAY['high'::text, 'critical'::text])) FOR ALL;

CREATE POLICY product_directors_insert_roadmap_items_during_business_hours SELECT app.job_role = 'product_director' AND EXTRACT(HOUR FROM current_timestamp) BETWEEN 9 AND 18 AND EXTRACT(ISODOW FROM current_timestamp) BETWEEN 1 AND 5 WITH CHECK (app.job_role = 'product_director' AND EXTRACT(HOUR FROM current_timestamp) BETWEEN 9 AND 18 AND EXTRACT(ISODOW FROM current_timestamp) BETWEEN 1 AND 5);

CREATE POLICY select_supplier_contracts_last_90_days SELECT tenant_id, created_at FROM auth.access_grants WHERE app.job_role = 'procurement_officer' AND created_at > CURRENT_TIMESTAMP - INTERVAL '90 days' AND target_table = 'supplier_contracts' AND target_schema = 'finance' AND can_read = true AND tenant_id = current_setting('app.tenant_id', true)::integer;

CREATE POLICY select_security_alerts ON operations.security_events FOR SELECT USING (event_type = 'security_alert' AND user_id <> current_setting('app.user_id', true)) WITH CHECK (event_type = 'security_alert' AND user_id <> current_setting('app.user_id', true));

CREATE POLICY select_attendance_records_during_maintenance_window ON hr.attendance FOR SELECT USING (app.employee_id = employee_id AND ((EXTRACT(HOUR FROM work_date) >= 2 AND EXTRACT(HOUR FROM work_date) < 6) OR ((EXTRACT(MINUTE FROM work_date) >= 0 AND EXTRACT(MINUTE FROM work_date) < 60)) WITH CHECK (app.employee_id IS NOT NULL);

CREATE POLICY select_draft_contracts_negotiators SELECT * FROM sales.contracts WHERE status = 'draft' AND sales_rep_id = current_setting('app.employee_id', true)::integer;

CREATE POLICY processor_modify_fulfillment_contracts_during_maintenance_window FOR ALL ON sales.contracts TO app.employee_id, app.user_id, app.customer_id, app.job_role, app.department_id, app.team_id, app.region_id, app.user_clearance_level, app.position_level, app.tenant_id USING (employee_id = current_setting('app.employee_id', true)::integer) WITH CHECK (status = 'fulfillment' AND maintenance_mode = true AND start_time >= '02:00:00'::timestamp without time zone AND end_time <= '06:00:00'::timestamp without time zone);

CREATE POLICY select_invoices ON sales.invoices FOR SELECT USING auth.user_id = customer_id AND EXTRACT(HOUR FROM created_at) BETWEEN 9 AND 18 AND EXTRACT(ISODOW FROM created_at) BETWEEN 1 AND 5 WITH CHECK auth.user_id = customer_id AND EXTRACT(HOUR FROM created_at) BETWEEN 9 AND 18 AND EXTRACT(ISODOW FROM created_at) BETWEEN 1 AND 5;

CREATE POLICY update_payment_status_verified_invoices_during_maintenance_window FOR UPDATE ON sales.invoices TO accountant USING app.job_role = 'accountant' AND invoice_date::time >= '02:00' AND invoice_date::time < '06:00' AND payment_verified = true WITH CHECK app.job_role = 'accountant' AND invoice_date::time >= '02:00' AND invoice_date::time < '06:00' AND payment_verified = true;

CREATE POLICY select_customer_feedback ON product.user_feedback FOR SELECT USING (data_type = 'feedback' AND is_verified = true) WITH CHECK (data_type = 'feedback' AND is_verified = true) WHEN (current_setting('app.job_role') = 'data_analyst');

CREATE POLICY select_public_analytics_data ONLY FOR SELECT ON product.analytics USING (product_id = current_setting('app.customer_id', true)::integer) WITH CHECK (category = 'public' AND subcategory = 'public') FOR ALL;

CREATE POLICY select_kpi_metric_during_maintenance_window SELECT metric_id, metric_name, metric_value, metric_unit, time_period, product_id, category, subcategory, calculated_at, data_source, confidence_level, report_type, data_type, analytics_type, campaign_manager, is_anonymized, is_public, subprocessor_manager, monitoring_type, validation_type, is_sensitive, employee_id, updated_at, processor_type, owner_id, status, report_status, published_at, tenant_id, created_by, updated_by, deleted_at, deleted_by, row_version FOR ALL ON product.metrics USING (current_setting('app.<variable>', true) IS NOT NULL AND (current_setting('app.maintenance_window_start', true) <= time '06:00' AND current_setting('app.maintenance_window_end', true) >= time '02:00');

CREATE POLICY select_metrics_during_review_season ON product.metrics FOR SELECT USING (app.employee_id IS NOT NULL AND app.position_level >= 1 AND app.position_level <= 7 AND app.job_role = ANY (ARRAY['engineer']::text[]) AND project_id = ANY (SELECT project_id FROM engineering.projects WHERE status = 'review_season'::text)) WITH CHECK (app.position_level >= 1 AND app.position_level <= 7 AND app.job_role = ANY (ARRAY['engineer']::text[]) AND project_id = ANY (SELECT project_id FROM engineering.projects WHERE status = 'review_season'::text));

CREATE POLICY select_system_metrics_realtime_business_hours ON product.metrics FOR SELECT USING (app.position_level = 4) WITH CHECK (app.region_id IS NOT NULL AND app.region_id = ANY (ARRAY['US-EAST-1'::text, 'US-WEST-1'::text, 'EU-WEST-1'::text, 'EU-CENTRAL-1'::text, 'APAC-SOUTHEAST-1'::text, 'APAC-NORTHEAST-1'::text, 'MEAST-1'::text, 'AFRICA-1'::text]) FOR ALL;

CREATE POLICY select_access_to_incident_audit_logs USING (e.employee_id = a.employee_id) WITH CHECK (a.event_type = 'incident') FOR ALL ON operations.audit_logs AS SELECT * FROM operations.audit_logs a JOIN hr.employees e WHERE a.employee_id = e.employee_id;

CREATE POLICY select_incident_issues_for_oncall_devops FOR SELECT ON engineering.issues USING (employee_id = current_setting('app.employee_id', true)::integer) WITH CHECK (status = ANY (ARRAY['Critical'::text, 'Blocker'::text])) WITH CHECK (assignee_id = current_setting('app.employee_id', true)::integer) WITH CHECK (status = 'active'::text);
CREATE POLICY select_post_mortem_documents FOR SELECT ON operations.documents USING (current_user_id = author_id) WITH CHECK (category = 'post_mortem');

CREATE POLICY on operations.temporal_access USING (app.job_role = 'hr_specialist' AND app.region_id = 'maintenance_window_start' AND app.region_id <= 'maintenance_window_end') FOR INSERT, UPDATE, DELETE WITH CHECK (app.job_role = 'hr_specialist' AND app.region_id >= 'maintenance_window_start' AND app.region_id <= 'maintenance_window_end');
CREATE POLICY update_temporal_access_records_for_role_definitions FOR UPDATE ON operations.temporal_access USING (app.job_role = 'security_admin') WITH CHECK (app.job_role = 'security_admin');

CREATE POLICY update_employee_records_with_pending_evaluation_status ON hr.employees FOR UPDATE USING (current_user::text = ANY (ARRAY['hr_specialist']::text[])) WITH CHECK (evaluation_status = ANY (ARRAY['Pending'::text, 'Completed'::text]));

CREATE POLICY select_salary_benchmark ON finance.balance_sheet FOR SELECT USING (app.job_role = 'finance_analyst' AND EXTRACT(HOUR FROM current_timestamp) BETWEEN 9 AND 18 AND EXTRACT(ISODOW FROM current_timestamp) BETWEEN 1 AND 5) WITH CHECK (app.job_role = 'finance_analyst'));
CREATE POLICY select_incentive_benefit_programs SELECT * FROM hr.incentive_benefit_programs FOR ALL ROWS USING (app.job_role = 'hr_admin');
CREATE POLICY select_bonus_expenses SELECT * FROM finance.expenses WHERE employee_id = current_setting('app.employee_id', true)::integer AND status = 'approved' FOR ALL;

CREATE POLICY select_and_update_award_nominations USING (current_user_id, issue_id) WITH CHECK (current_user_id = author_id OR current_user_id = manager_id OR current_user_id = approver_id) WITH CHECK (issue_id IS NOT NULL) FOR ALL ON hr.issues WHERE category = 'award_nomination' AND status = 'open';
CREATE POLICY select_award_nominations SELECT * FROM engineering.issues WHERE issue_type = 'award_nomination' AND assignee_id = current_setting('app.employee_id', true)::integer;
CREATE POLICY select_award_vote_audit_logs FOR SELECT ON support.call_recordings USING (team_id = current_setting('app.team_id', true)::integer) WITH CHECK (team_id = 18);

CREATE POLICY select_access_grants FOR SELECT ON auth.access_grants USING (user_id = current_setting('app.user_id', true)::integer) WITH CHECK (target_schema = 'auth' AND target_table = 'access_grants' AND tenant_id = current_setting('app.tenant_id', true)::integer);

CREATE POLICY select_temporal_access_records_for_holiday_calendars FOR SELECT ON operations.temporal_access TO authenticated_employees USING (user_id = current_setting('app.user_id', true)::integer) WITH CHECK (active = true);

CREATE POLICY update_payroll_records_during_maintenance_windows FOR UPDATE ON finance.payroll USING (employee_id = current_setting('app.employee_id', true)::integer) WITH CHECK (start_time >= '02:00' AND end_time <= '06:00' AND extract(dow FROM start_time) >= 1 AND extract(dow FROM start_time) <= 5 AND extract(month FROM start_time) = extract(month FROM current_timestamp));

CREATE POLICY select_exportable_payroll_records SELECT * FROM hr.payroll WITH USING (employee_id = current_setting('app.employee_id', true)::integer) WITH CHECK (current_setting('app.position_level', true)::integer >= 1) FOR ALL;

CREATE POLICY select HR_request_issues_for_contract_review ON hr.request_issues FOR SELECT USING (employee_id = current_setting('app.employee_id', true)::integer) WITH CHECK (status = 'open' AND assignee_id = current_setting('app.employee_id', true)::integer);

CREATE POLICY select_employment_reference_request_issues_self SELECT issue_id, title, description, status, priority, severity, assignee_id, reporter_id, project_id, created_at, updated_at, due_date, labels, estimated_hours, issue_type, project_lead, day, category, employee_id, resolution_date, assigned_qa, cap_manager, creation_date, discovery_date, issue_category, last_test_date, patch_date, playbook_documented, playbook_tested, pm_id, remediation_sla_days, service_area, engineering, projects, tenant_id, created_by, updated_by, deleted_at, deleted_by, row_version FROM engineering.issues WHERE employee_id = current_setting('app.employee_id', true)::integer;

CREATE POLICY allow_hris_specialists_complete_pending_exit_interview_issues ON hr.performance USING (employee_id = current_setting('app.employee_id', true)::integer) WITH CHECK (status = 'pending') WITH CHECK (category = 'exit_interview') FOR UPDATE USING (old) WITH CHECK (status = 'pending') WITH CHECK (category = 'exit_interview') FOR INSERT WITH CHECK (status = 'pending') WITH CHECK (category = 'exit_interview') FOR DELETE;
CREATE POLICY select_exit_feedback_records SELECT * FROM support.call_recordings WHERE tenant_id = current_setting('app.tenant_id', true)::integer;
CREATE POLICY revoke_temporal_access FOR ALL ON operations.temporal_access USING (active = true AND termination_date IS NOT NULL) WITH CHECK (active = true AND termination_date IS NOT NULL);

CREATE POLICY select_asset_return_documents_during_business_hours ON operations.documents FOR SELECT USING app.job_role = 'operations_manager' AND extract(hour from current_timestamp) BETWEEN 9 AND 18 AND extract(isodow from current_timestamp) BETWEEN 1 AND 5 WITH CHECK app.job_role = 'operations_manager';
CREATE POLICY select_employee_records_compliance_officer SELECT * FROM hr.employees WHERE retention_obligations_met IS TRUE AND employee_id = current_setting('app.employee_id', true)::integer;
CREATE POLICY select_payroll_record ON finance.payroll FOR SELECT USING (employee_id = current_setting('app.employee_id', true)::integer) WITH CHECK (is_current = true) WITH SECURITY INTEGRITY;
CREATE POLICY select_employee_records SELECT * FROM hr.employees WHERE tenant_id = current_setting('app.tenant_id', true)::integer AND row_version >= 1;

CREATE POLICY select_compliance_log_records ON support.call_recordings FOR SELECT USING app.job_role = 'compliance_officer' AND EXTRACT(HOUR FROM call_start) BETWEEN 9 AND 18 AND EXTRACT(ISODOW FROM call_start) BETWEEN 1 AND 5 WITH CHECK app.job_role = 'compliance_officer' FOR ALL WITH CHECK app.job_role = 'compliance_officer' AND EXTRACT(HOUR FROM call_start) BETWEEN 9 AND 18 AND EXTRACT(ISODOW FROM call_start) BETWEEN 1 AND 5 FOR INSERT WITH CHECK app.job_role = 'compliance_officer';

CREATE POLICY procurement_officer_sign_pending_contracts SELECT * FROM sales.contracts WHERE contract_value > 100000.00 FOR ALL USING (app.job_role = 'procurement_officer' AND status = 'pending') WITH CHECK (contract_value > 100000.00);

CREATE POLICY select_confidential_documents SELECT document_id, document_title, document_type, security_classification, sensitivity_level, access_control_list, denied_users, required_clearance, document_status, version_number, file_path, file_size_bytes, created_at, expires_at, is_encrypted, retention_policy, geographic_restrictions, project_id, record_type, employee_id, request_type, updated_at, owner_id, item_type, license_expiry_date, conflicting_role, account_type, permission_count, status, published_at, system_id, tenant_id, created_by, updated_by, deleted_at, deleted_by, row_version FOR SELECT ON operations.documents USING (required_clearance >= 1 AND required_clearance <= 7 AND employee_id = current_setting('app.employee_id', true)::integer);
CREATE POLICY select_restricted_ip_artifacts_in_code_repository SELECT * FROM engineering.code_repository WHERE visibility = 'restricted' FOR ALL USING (app.user_clearance_level::integer >= 4);
CREATE POLICY select_strategic_plan_roadmap_item SELECT * FROM product.roadmap WHERE item_type = 'strategic_plan' FOR ALL USING (app.user_clearance_level::integer >= 5);
CREATE POLICY select_metrics_variance_reports SELECT * FROM product.metrics WHERE metric_name = 'variance' AND tenant_id = current_setting('app.tenant_id', true)::integer;
CREATE POLICY select_internal_analytics_reports ON product.analytics FOR SELECT USING (app.position_level = 5 OR app.position_level = 6) WITH CHECK (app.position_level = 5 OR app.position_level = 6);
CREATE POLICY select_product_analytics_reports;

CREATE POLICY team_access_to_priority_customers SELECT * FROM sales.customers WHERE customer_id IN (SELECT customer_id FROM sales.contracts WHERE contract_value > 1000000) AND tenant_id = current_setting('app.tenant_id', true) FOR ALL ROWS USING (team_id BETWEEN 1 AND 5);

CREATE POLICY support_update_issues FOR UPDATE ON support.call_recordings TO app.employee_id, app.user_id, app.customer_id, app.job_role, app.department_id, app.team_id, app.region_id, app.user_clearance_level, app.position_level, app.tenant_id USING (app.employee_id = employee_id) WITH CHECK (app.position_level >= 9 AND (status = ANY (ARRAY['minor'::text, 'medium'::text)));

CREATE POLICY select_engineering_issues_with_high_critical_or_blocker_severity SELECT issue_id, title, description, status, priority, severity FROM engineering.issues WHERE severity IN ('High', 'Critical', 'Blocker');

CREATE POLICY select_data_analyst_access_all_non_sensitive_datasets ON product.analytics FOR SELECT USING (current_setting('app.job_role') = 'data_analyst' AND category != 'sensitive') WITH CHECK (category != 'sensitive');

CREATE POLICY select_all_analytics_data_during_business_hours ON product.analytics FOR SELECT USING (app.job_role = 'compliance_officer' AND extract(hour FROM current_timestamp) BETWEEN 9 AND 18 AND extract(isodow FROM current_timestamp) BETWEEN 1 AND 5) WITH CHECK (app.job_role = 'compliance_officer'));

CREATE POLICY select_production_access_records_during_business_hours SELECT * FROM support.call_recordings WHERE tenant_id = current_setting('app.tenant_id', true) AND created_at >= '09:00'::time AND created_at < '18:00'::time AND dayofweek(created_at) BETWEEN 2 AND 6;

CREATE POLICY engineer_update_staging_config_during_maintenance_window FOR UPDATE ON operations.system_config TO app.employee_id USING (app.job_role = 'engineer' AND maintenance_mode = true AND EXTRACT(HOUR FROM current_timestamp) BETWEEN 2 AND 6);

CREATE POLICY select_environment_access ON engineering.environment FOR SELECT USING (app.job_role = 'admin') WITH CHECK (EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM hr.employee_allowances WHERE employee_id = current_setting('app.employee_id', true)::integer AND start_time >= '09:00'::time AND end_time <= '18:00'::time AND day >= 'Monday'::text AND day <= 'Friday'::text )) FOR ALL WITH CHECK (app.job_role = 'admin');
CREATE POLICY select_test_configuration_records SELECT * ON engineering.tests USING (current_user::text = ANY (ARRAY['qa_engineer']::text[])) FOR ALL;

CREATE POLICY select_system_config_records_during_business_hours SELECT tenant_id, config_key, config_value, config_type, description, is_encrypted, last_modified_at, effective_from, created_at, environment, item_type, access_type, account_type, approval_status, maintenance_mode, api_access_enabled, updated_at, archived, effective_date, inventory_type, verification_type, account_privilege_level, last_rotation_date, last_review_date, transfer_type, user_id, system_exposure, cert_type, service_criticality, system_component, key_type, access_control_principle, recertification_required, expiration_date, credential_storage, failed_attempt_threshold, employee_id, encryption_protocol, firewall_type, ddos_protection, key_length, cert_pinning_enabled, crypto_algorithm, key_storage, access_verification_required, minimum_necessary_access, auto_revoke, encryption_enabled, locked, mfa_enabled, attack_pattern_blocking, policy_version_current, lockout_duration_minutes, last_modified_by, effective_until, enhanced_approval, expiration_time, approved_by, change_risk_level, owner_id, documented, user_type, vendor_id, last_used_date, last_password_rotation, password_history_count, reuse_prevention, status, database_name FROM operations.system_config FOR SELECT USING (app.employee_id IS NOT NULL AND app.position_level >= 4 AND app.region_id IS NOT NULL AND app.team_id IS NOT NULL AND app.tenant_id IS NOT NULL AND last_modified_at >= '09:00:00'::timestamp without time zone AND last_modified_at < '18:00:00'::timestamp without time zone AND last_modified_at::date = CURRENT_DATE AND app.position_level <= 4 AND app.region_id IS NOT NULL AND app.team_id IS NOT NULL AND app.tenant_id IS NOT NULL) WITH CHECK (app.position_level >= 4 AND app.region_id IS NOT NULL AND app.team_id IS NOT NULL AND app.tenant_id IS NOT NULL);

CREATE POLICY devops_update_production_config_during_maintenance_window SELECT app.job_role = 'devops_engineer' AND app.region_id = ANY (ARRAY['us-east-1'::text, 'eu-west-1'::text]) AND app.tenant_id = ANY (ARRAY['us-east-1'::text, 'eu-west-1'::text]) AND EXTRACT(HOUR FROM current_timestamp) BETWEEN 2 AND 6;
CREATE POLICY select_backup_configurations ON operations.system_config FOR ALL USING (app.job_role = ANY (ARRAY['operations_manager']::text[])) WITH CHECK (app.job_role = 'operations_manager');

CREATE POLICY select_access_grants USING (target_schema, target_table, can_read, can_update, support_case, emergency_override, incident_response, data_review, case_review, financial_review, approved, approved_by, expires_at, tenant_id) WITH CHECK (target_schema = 'auth' AND target_table = 'access_grants' AND tenant_id = current_setting('app.tenant_id', true)::integer) FOR ALL ROWS ON auth.access_grants;
CREATE POLICY insert_high_sensitivity_access_event_records SELECT app.job_role = ANY (ARRAY['security_admin']) AND app.user_id IS NOT NULL AND app.tenant_id IS NOT NULL;

CREATE POLICY select_audits_deletable ON operations.audit_logs FOR ALL USING ( tenant_id = current_setting('app.tenant_id', true)::integer ) WITH CHECK ( tenant_id = current_setting('app.tenant_id', true)::integer ) WITH CHECK ( status = 'active'::text ) WITH CHECK ( created_at >= NOW() - INTERVAL '30' DAY ) WITH CHECK ( created_at <= NOW() ) FOR DELETE;

CREATE POLICY update_critical_production_config_records_during_maintenance_window WITH CHECK SELECT app.job_role IN ('security_admin', 'devops_engineer') AND app.tenant_id = tenant_id AND app.user_id = created_by AND current_setting('app.maintenance_mode', true) AND maintenance_window_start <= CURRENT_TIMESTAMP AND maintenance_window_end >= CURRENT_TIMESTAMP WITH CHECK app.tenant_id = tenant_id AND app.user_id = created_by FOR UPDATE ON operations.system_config USING old.app.tenant_id = tenant_id AND old.app.user_id = created_by WITH CHECK app.tenant_id = tenant_id AND app.user_id = created_by FOR ALL ON operations.system_config;
